goal: Explain token economics for graph and harness engineering using explicitly illustrative models

objectives.description: Inspect how total execution spending is split across nodes and token categories
objectives.evidenceOfLearning: Identify the reasoner contribution and reconcile the total

objectives.description: Change context size and token pricing and explain the cost differences
objectives.evidenceOfLearning: Predict the result of changing an input and verify the computed value

objectives.description: Calculate expected cost per attempt and per accepted task
objectives.evidenceOfLearning: Explain why dividing by acceptance changes cost per accepted task

objectives.description: Trace control and state between graph nodes
objectives.evidenceOfLearning: Explain the selected context each participant receives

objectives.description: Explain why graph state differs from submitted model context
objectives.evidenceOfLearning: Explain why storing state does not establish prefix reuse

objectives.description: Compare context, orchestration, skill loading and prefix choices
objectives.evidenceOfLearning: Justify one architecture choice given a concrete constraint

objectives.description: Calculate conditional and overall request outcome probabilities
objectives.evidenceOfLearning: Multiply conditional probabilities along a path

objectives.description: Vary request count to calculate amortized cache cost
objectives.evidenceOfLearning: Explain why the average approaches the read cost

objectives.description: Answer the taught inclusive-cache accounting question
objectives.evidenceOfLearning: Select 80 fresh input tokens and explain subtraction

sections.title: Cost allocation
sections.activity: Inspect how total execution spending is split across nodes and token categories
sections.rationale: Illustrative USD BreakdownTree shows mutually exclusive contributions; Table provides exact reconciliation from the same source model.

presentation.strategy: Read inspects branches and the exact Table; Present follows focused subtree splits.

sections.title: Pricing sensitivity
sections.activity: Change context size and token pricing and explain the cost differences
sections.rationale: FormulaSandbox exposes sensitivity of an illustrative USD model with explicit exclusive token categories and assumptions.

presentation.strategy: Demonstrate default values then meaningful variable changes; Read allows experiments.

sections.title: Outcome economics
sections.activity: Calculate expected cost per attempt and per accepted task
sections.rationale: Illustrative one-retry assumptions use USD and probabilities; FormulaSandbox reproduces defaults and keeps acceptance positive.

presentation.strategy: Read varies retry and acceptance inputs; Present demonstrates computed outputs.

sections.title: Graph execution
sections.activity: Trace control and state between graph nodes
sections.rationale: Flowchart preserves routing and message order; no benchmark claims.

presentation.strategy: initialView: sequence; follow the execution journey through node-specific contexts.

sections.title: Context semantics
sections.activity: Explain why graph state differs from submitted model context
sections.rationale: Nuanced connected prose preserves provider qualifications that a table would obscure; this supports interpreting the preceding graph rather than duplicating its transitions.

presentation.strategy: Read supports careful wording; Present narrates the distinction and limitations.

sections.title: Architecture choices
sections.activity: Compare context, orchestration, skill loading and prefix choices
sections.rationale: TradeoffSandbox compares qualitative alternatives using supplied design reasoning; there are no invented numeric scores.

presentation.strategy: Read explores each choice; Present demonstrates strengths and limitations.

sections.title: Conditional cache outcomes
sections.activity: Calculate conditional and overall request outcome probabilities
sections.rationale: Illustrative probabilities form exhaustive sibling sets; BreakdownTree distinguishes conditional branches from path products.

presentation.strategy: Read inspects denominators; Present focuses each conditional split.

sections.title: Cache amortization
sections.activity: Vary request count to calculate amortized cache cost
sections.rationale: Illustrative USD FormulaSandbox assumes one write followed by cache reads; no expiry or misses.

presentation.strategy: Read varies requests; Present demonstrates default and larger request counts.

sections.title: Accounting assessment
sections.activity: Answer the taught inclusive-cache accounting question
sections.rationale: Quiz collects an explicit response after the context and pricing explanation.

presentation.strategy: Present demonstrates authored feedback with separate state; Read records learner attempts.

assessment.successCriterion: Choose 80 fresh tokens for an inclusive report of 100 with 20 cache reads.
